title: Add Retry Logic for Flaky Payment API Calls
user_request: Outbound payment requests fail intermittently with timeout errors. Add exponential backoff and retry logic, and verify with the payment service tests.

steps.thought: Inspect the payment client to find the timeout-prone HTTP call.
Wrap the outbound request with retry logic using exponential backoff for transient failures.

observation.stdout: Updated payment request with retry/backoff logic.

steps.thought: Run the payment tests to confirm the retry path works under flaky timeout conditions.

final_solution: Added exponential backoff retry handling around payment requests to survive transient timeouts without breaking the API contract.

title: Fix Divide-by-Zero in Billing Summary Report
user_request: The billing summary endpoint crashes when there are zero invoices in a period. Guard the division and return a stable zero-value summary.

steps.thought: Read the billing summary logic and find the division by zero case.
Guard against empty invoice lists and return 0 for the computed average.
Verify the edge-case regression test passes.

final_solution: Handled empty invoice collections before division, ensuring the billing summary returns zero instead of crashing.

title: Enforce Admin Authentication on Protected Routes
user_request: Protected admin pages are accessible without authentication. Add a proper admin-only guard and keep route behavior consistent with the security test suite.

steps.thought: Inspect the route definition and auth helper to identify the missing access check.
Add an admin authorization dependency and reject unauthenticated access with a 401 response.

observation.stdout: Added admin guard dependency to protected route.

steps.thought: Run the auth and route tests to confirm unauthorized access is blocked.

final_solution: Protected admin routes behind an authentication dependency, preventing unauthenticated access while preserving valid admin access.
